title: Q-KG-base-rates: knowledge graph of all base-rates data (DATAGRAPH-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every executor run; DATAGRAPH-1
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation datagraph --live
**Status:** open

DATAGRAPH-1: base-rates runs its own Worker in ultrastable/base-rates. Map its entries with the shared engine seed/worker/src/knowledge.js (vendored, never edited), serve /api/graph and /api/graph/health from that map, then set this row to built.

**Prediction:** kg_systems_built >= 6 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** changing the entry format or the loop.
**Closing probe:** GET https://base-rates.ultrastable.org/api/graph/health expect 200
